known_blockers.description: CapabilityScopeArtifact.constraints is currently not evaluated by verifyAuthorityAtDecisionTime(); placing an autonomy caveat there would be silently non-binding.
known_blockers.required_before_use: Define and prove fail-closed constraint evaluation. Unknown, unsupported or unevaluated critical constraints must deny authority rather than be ignored.

known_blockers.description: Existing grants may have no autonomy caveat.
known_blockers.required_before_use: Prove that absence resolves to the minimum autonomy ceiling and cannot silently mean unrestricted autonomy; assess compatibility with existing governed flows.

known_blockers.description: Authority and autonomy evaluation could otherwise be assembled from different grants.
known_blockers.required_before_use: Any autonomy ceiling used by a gate must be derived from the exact same pinned capability grant ref/hash present in the authority verification closure for that action.

known_blockers.description: Delegation paths can attenuate authority but no autonomy-ceiling monotonicity rule exists.
known_blockers.required_before_use: If autonomy constraints propagate through delegation, each child ceiling must be verifier-proven less than or equal to its parent ceiling across the complete canonical delegation path.

rows.proposed_semantics: Ordinal autonomy scale L0-L6 describing human-supervision topology only; no level grants action authority.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE from existing workflow/checkpoint or delegation semantics
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with existing execution/governance levels
MECHANISM_ONLY if the scale is only presentation over existing constraints
WRONG_ABSTRACTION_LEVEL if one ordinal collapses distinct supervision dimensions
preconditions: Define exact ordering and prove monotonicity
Define whether every adjacent level is strictly stronger in autonomous execution topology

rows.proposed_semantics: A critical, monotone autonomy ceiling attached to an already-authorized grant or equivalent canonical authority surface.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE from CapabilityScopeArtifact.constraints
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with CapabilityGrantArtifact or TrustDelegationArtifact constraints
MECHANISM_ONLY if the ceiling is merely a verifier projection
preconditions: AUTO-PRE-01
AUTO-PRE-02
AUTO-PRE-03
AUTO-PRE-04
Unknown constraint types must fail closed
Missing caveat must resolve to minimum autonomy ceiling

rows.proposed_semantics: Canonical policy describing supervision constraints, execution-identity binding, checkpoint requirements and derivation rules without granting authority.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE from CapabilityPolicyArtifact, ExecutionIdentityArtifact and workflow contract semantics
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with an existing policy artifact
MECHANISM_ONLY if all fields are verifier configuration
WRONG_ABSTRACTION_LEVEL if policy is specialized to one agent or prematurely platform-generic
preconditions: Execution identity must bind load-bearing execution config
Model identity requirement must be derived from capability/execution dependency, never self-declared
Checkpoint applicability must derive from pinned workflow/action definitions

rows.proposed_semantics: Verifier result that derives the effective autonomy ceiling from pinned sources; it does not decide action authority or material action allowance.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE as a pure recomputable projection from policy/grant/evidence/runtime/checkpoint inputs
MECHANISM_ONLY as verifier output that need not be a canonical artifact
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with existing decision bindings or execution verification artifacts
preconditions: Every ceiling source must be pinned by ref/hash
Missing or unverifiable source maps to minimum ceiling
Verifier release ref/hash must be preserved because derivation semantics are versioned
Historical re-verification must retain every status attestation used at evaluated_at

rows.proposed_semantics: ALLOW/DENY decision that crosses independently verified authority, autonomy, runtime eligibility, evidence sufficiency and pinned action semantics.
falsification_tests: SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with AuthorityDecisionBinding
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with LU 04E authority-decision/persistence closure semantics
DERIVABLE as a recomputable binding rather than a new artifact family
MECHANISM_ONLY if it is only a transient mutation-boundary verifier result
WRONG_ABSTRACTION_LEVEL if a generic gate is introduced before a second concrete consumer exists
preconditions: Gate must prove authority and autonomy use the exact same grant ref/hash
required_autonomy_level must derive from pinned action definition, never request data
deny_reasons must be set-valued and deterministic
valid_until must equal the minimum valid-until/freshness bound of all load-bearing inputs
Mutation boundary must re-check freshness or require a fresh status attestation
Endpoint/mutation implementation must declare and enforce its own action_id

rows.proposed_semantics: Replay-prevention binding between one accepted gate decision and one mutation slot.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE from existing idempotency/mutation-slot semantics
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with an existing execution-attempt or persistence ledger
MECHANISM_ONLY if a unique transactional constraint provides the full semantics without a new artifact
preconditions: Consumption must be atomic with the mutation using a unique mutation-slot constraint in the same transaction
Define whether a failed mutation consumes the decision
TTL/freshness and consumption/replay prevention must remain separate semantics

rows.proposed_semantics: Canonical mapping from action_id to materiality, required autonomy level, mutation semantics and checkpoint applicability.
falsification_tests: DERIVABLE from capability and workflow definitions
SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE with an existing capability/workflow registry
MECHANISM_ONLY if endpoint-owned constants plus canonical workflow policy already provide the same binding
WRONG_ABSTRACTION_LEVEL if a platform-wide registry is generalized before multiple consumers require it
preconditions: Unknown action/class/materiality must fail closed as material
Changing materiality or required autonomy level is itself a governed material mutation
Entries require canonical identity, pinning, versioning and authority
Mutation boundary must reject gate decisions for action_id values other than the endpoint's declared action
